anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion erupts from the black sedan parked near the ship, producing a massive fireball and smoke plume.

The aftermath of the explosion continues: a large smoke cloud rises and expands, with debris visible in the air and reflection on the water; the car is destroyed and no longer visible as a distinct vehicle.
A secondary, violent explosion occurs at the same location, violently ejecting debris and a person into the air; the car is now engulfed in flames and smoke.
A dark-colored car is severely damaged and engulfed in intense flames and thick black smoke, indicating it has recently crashed and caught fire.

The initial violent ignition of the vehicle fire appears explosive, with a sudden large burst of flame and smoke emerging from the car's midsection, consistent with a fuel or gas explosion following impact.
